data.name: Carboneyes
data.description: Carboneyes is a UK-based biochar carbon removal company that pyrolyzes waste sugarcane bagasse into biochar and donates it to smallholder sugarcane farmers in Africa. The company generates carbon removal credits by permanently storing carbon in soil, targeting over 500,000 tonnes of CO2 removal and 200,000 tonnes of biochar donation by 2030.
